name: repo presentation
description: Present a built repository the way this estate presents its apps: a designed landing page at docs/index.html, the app at docs/play/, screenshots taken with headless Chromium, local SVG badges generated rather than fetched, and a README that leads with them. Use when publishing a new build/publish repo, or when an existing one has no landing page, no screenshots, or a README with no badges. Also covers making the landing page visually distinct from the app itself, and embedding the app as a live demo rather than a screenshot. Every page it produces is light by default with a remembered dark toggle. Also covers the service-worker trap that hides shipped updates.
